      "evidence": "Extensively modifies the libmultiprocess subtree and Cap'n Proto machinery to implement native request cancellation across IPC.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The PR adds native Cap'n Proto request cancellation support to libmultiprocess, replacing out-of-band interrupt calls. As ryanofsky notes, this allows clients to cancel in-flight blocking requests natively and efficiently rather than issuing separate IPC calls, providing a durable capability to IPC clients and servers."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Holds the Mining label and modifies interfaces::Mining blocking methods and mining.capnp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deprecates dedicated interrupt() methods in favor of passing cancellation arguments to blocking calls like waitTipChanged and waitNext. This cleans up and stabilizes the IPC interface for external template providers without affecting template validity or block construction performance."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
